# RecoverRevenue

> RecoverRevenue builds missed call text back, speed-to-lead and past-estimate reactivation systems for Florida roofing, HVAC, plumbing and home service contractors. Founded by Chase Szarek, based in Tampa Bay, FL. Live in 7 business days. Guarantee: 15 qualified jobs in 60 days; the monthly fee isn't charged until the 15th booked job.

Not affiliated with Recovered Revenue (recoveredrevenue.com), a healthcare revenue cycle firm.

## What we do
- Missed call text back: every unanswered call gets a text from the contractor's business within seconds, which qualifies the job and books it into their calendar.
- Past-estimate reactivation: automatic, personal follow-up on stalled quotes and past customers.
- Review collection: automated Google review requests after completed jobs.

## Who it's for
Owner-run Florida service contractors with crews in the field: roofing first, also HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling and exterior trades.
